title: Draw the state diagram
summary: The same FCFS machine, printing the state of every process at every millisecond.
hints: Record the state of every process in a table `[process][time]` while you simulate, and print it at the end.
A process that has terminated shows `T` until the last process ends; a process not yet arrived shows `.`.
The line of every process is as long as the whole simulation (the instant at which the last process terminates).
